head: codex/5692-pr-closing-linkage-policy
title: [v0.91.7][tools] Require PR closing linkage for issue publication
body:
Closes #5692

## Summary
- require implementation PR bodies to use a GitHub closing keyword for the tracked issue
- make csdlc-publish reject bare issue mentions during request and remote PR validation
- bind qualified closing references to the governed repository so cross-repo refs cannot satisfy ADL issue closeout

## Validation
- cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate6
- cargo check --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --bin csdlc-publish
- cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
- git diff --check

## Review
- bounded subagent review found one P1 cross-repo qualified-reference gap
- fixed and re-reviewed clean at b23a8f87e76536fdbf65a6be78ca64b2a3918b19
